title: R2b — the LSP blocks, bootstrap lsp and code:lsp:check

keeps.check: Build the worktree engine (go build -o <tmp>/bootstrap ./cmd/bootstrap in cli/) and export BOOTSTRAP_BIN=<tmp>/bootstrap. In a new scratch git repo, run env -u MISE_PROJECT_ROOT BOOTSTRAP_CONFIG=/nonexistent <tmp>/bootstrap init --no-tui --yes --clone <worktree>, add the go and node tools (<tmp>/bootstrap add tool go --yes --clone <worktree>, the same for node), commit, mise trust. Run <tmp>/bootstrap lsp --json --clone <worktree>; then MISE_ENV=dev mise run code:lsp:check; then MISE_ENV=dev mise install; then MISE_ENV=dev mise run code:lsp:check again.
keeps.pass: lsp --json lists gopls and typescript-lsp, each with command mise, args starting x, --, and extensionToLanguage as D4 says. The first code:lsp:check exits 1 and names the missing servers with mise install; after mise install it exits 0.

keeps.check: In a scratch repo that selects kotlin and java, run MISE_ENV=dev mise install.
keeps.pass: kotlin-lsp and jdtls install from their http pins; MISE_ENV=dev mise which jdtls prints a path, and MISE_ENV=dev mise x -- jdtls --help runs (D17).

keeps.check: In a scratch repo that selects rust, run MISE_ENV=dev mise install, then MISE_ENV=dev mise which rust-analyzer.
keeps.pass: The path is under the aqua install of rust-analyzer, not the rustup proxy of core:rust (D25).

keeps.check: In a scratch repo that selects flutter, python (with a pyproject.toml) and go, with BOOTSTRAP_BIN=<tmp>/bootstrap, run MISE_ENV=dev mise install, then MISE_ENV=dev mise run code:lsp:check.
keeps.pass: code:lsp:check exits 0: dart-lsp, pyrefly and gopls resolve (D31).

release_levels.reason: New behaviour with no break: [lsp] blocks and dev pins in eight language tools, bootstrap lsp, describe's lsp field (additive) and code:lsp:check. It goes into the one bootstrap@4.0.0 tag (R1b D16).

decisions.decision: Which language tools get an [lsp] block?
decisions.ruling: User: every language tool: kotlin, swift, flutter, node, go, python, rust and java.
decisions.rejected: The four stackgen serves (kotlin, swift, flutter, node); kotlin only.

decisions.decision: The Python LSP server.
decisions.ruling: pyrefly (Recommended): pyrefly lsp, from the pipx:pyrefly pin the python tool has today.

decisions.decision: The Java LSP server (jdtls is not in the mise registry).
decisions.ruling: jdtls by http pin (Recommended): a dev-only http:jdtls pin of the Eclipse jdtls milestone archive, in the form of kotlin-lsp. The unit verifies the URLs and stops with a question if they do not resolve.

decisions.decision: The shape of the [lsp] block and of bootstrap lsp --json.
decisions.ruling: Claude-ready output (Recommended): [lsp.<server>] with command, args, extensions (".ext" = "language"), startup_timeout (optional) and source (a mise tool this tool pins, or "host"). bootstrap lsp --json prints data = {servers: {<server>: {command: mise, args: [x, --, <command>, <args>...], extensionToLanguage, startupTimeout}}} for the repo's selected tools, so stackgen copies each entry verbatim.
decisions.rejected: Raw data only, formatted by stackgen.

decisions.decision: What does code:lsp:check check?
decisions.ruling: Each server resolves (Recommended): the mise tool ships code/lsp/check; it reads bootstrap lsp --json and tests that each server's command resolves under mise x -- in the dev env. It starts no server. A missing server prints one line with the fix; exit 1 if any is missing, 0 if all resolve or the repo has none.

decisions.decision: The lsp command and describe's lsp field.
decisions.ruling: Stated by the planner, confirmed at the shape gate: bootstrap lsp lists the servers of the repo's selected tools, one line each, or in the R1b envelope with --json. describe --json gets an lsp field with the same servers object (additive, R1b D7). contract lists lsp in commands. Outside a repo, or with no .config/bootstrap/, lsp exits 2 like describe (R1b D28).

decisions.decision: What does check refuse in an [lsp] block?
decisions.ruling: Stated by the planner, confirmed at the shape gate: code 2 for a block with no command, or no or empty extensions; one server name in two tools; a source that is neither "host" nor a mise tool that the same tool pins.

decisions.decision: Where do the new server pins go?
decisions.ruling: Stated by the planner, confirmed at the shape gate: every new pin is dev-only, as kotlin-lsp is: go:golang.org/x/tools/gopls (go), npm:typescript-language-server and npm:typescript (node), aqua:rust-lang/rust-analyzer (rust), http:jdtls (java). Verified 2026-11-14: only rust-analyzer is in the mise registry (aqua:rust-lang/rust-analyzer).

decisions.decision: Backlog item B28 (install a Claude marketplace and plugins, identify LSP servers).
decisions.ruling: Stated by the planner, confirmed at the shape gate: R2b lands one piece of B28 (identify the LSP servers); R2c (plugins and setup:ai) finishes it.

decisions.decision: What does R2b require?
decisions.ruling: Stated by the planner, confirmed at the shape gate: R2a (docs/plans/2026-11-14-git-tasks), the end of the chain on cli/ and repo/tools/. Priority 90 (10 + 80).

decisions.decision: The review unit and the execution mode.
decisions.ruling: One review unit, after the tests: the plan lands engine Go code, download pins and a task script. teams: wave 1 holds U1 and U2, and wave 2 holds U3 and U4.

decisions.decision: Round 1 gap 1: the pipx:pyrefly pin has requires_found = [pyproject.toml].
decisions.ruling: A server follows the requires_found of its source pin: when the pin is not active in the repo, bootstrap lsp, describe and code:lsp:check leave that server out.
decisions.rejected: List it and fail the check.

decisions.decision: Round 1 gap 2: node has two new pins, but source holds one string.
decisions.ruling: source names the pin that provides the command: npm:typescript-language-server. npm:typescript is a support pin that no rule names.

decisions.decision: Round 1 gap 3: stackgen's swift pack sets startupTimeout 1000.
decisions.ruling: Match stackgen: startup_timeout = 1000 for sourcekit-lsp, so the vwf-tools entry does not change when stackgen switches.

decisions.decision: Round 1 gap 4: the typescript pack also maps .tsx and .jsx and sets startupTimeout 60000.
decisions.ruling: Keep them: U2 copies the extension map and the startupTimeout of claude-plugins stacks/language/typescript/pack.yaml verbatim.

decisions.decision: Round 1 gap 5: command -v passes for any binary on PATH.
decisions.ruling: For a pinned server the check uses MISE_ENV=dev mise which <command>, which resolves only a mise-managed binary; for a host server it uses xcrun --find sourcekit-lsp. K1 then gives the same result on each machine.

decisions.decision: Round 1 gap 6: bin/jdtls is a Python launcher; the java tool pins no Python; the http backend bin path is not recorded.
decisions.ruling: The launcher uses the host python3 (macOS Xcode CLT and the Linux CI have it); the java tool gets no Python dependency. U2 verifies that the http pin exposes bin/jdtls (for example with the backend's bin-path option) and stops with a question if it cannot. K2 checks that mise which jdtls resolves and jdtls --help runs.

decisions.decision: Round 2 gap 1: bun and android are also language tools.
decisions.ruling: Both are out on purpose: android code uses the kotlin tool's server; a bun-only repo has no TypeScript server in R2b (parked for a later plan).
decisions.rejected: A second TypeScript server in bun.

decisions.decision: Round 2 gap 2: a tool only in ci never gets its [mise_env.dev.tools] pin.
decisions.ruling: The D12 rule: a server follows its source pin; a dev-only pin is active only when the tool's envs include dev; otherwise lsp, describe and the check leave the server out.
decisions.rejected: List it and fail the check.

decisions.decision: Round 2 gap 3: how the bash case stubs mise which with no network.
decisions.ruling: The case runs the task file directly with bash, not through mise run, with a PATH shim for mise that answers which, and a BOOTSTRAP_BIN stub.
decisions.rejected: A real installed binary; an env hook in the task.

decisions.decision: Round 2 gap 4: the node tool installs npm packages through aube.
decisions.ruling: U2 verifies in a scratch repo with node: MISE_ENV=dev mise install, then mise which typescript-language-server; if it fails, U2 stops with a question. K1 also covers it.

decisions.decision: Round 2 gap 5: the fix line for a missing sourcekit-lsp.
decisions.ruling: install the Xcode Command Line Tools (xcode-select --install) or Xcode.

decisions.decision: Round 2 gap 6: a broken sentence in 03-lsp-check.md and the case order in 04-tests.md.
decisions.ruling: Correct the sentence and the order.

decisions.decision: Round 3 gap 1: each lsp --json entry has command mise and no source, so the check cannot find the real command or tell a host server.
decisions.ruling: bootstrap lsp --json data gets a second map beside servers: checks = {<server>: {command: <the first word of the [lsp] command>, source: <the source>}}. The servers entries stay verbatim Claude entries (D4); checks is additive. code:lsp:check reads checks.
decisions.rejected: Hard-code sourcekit-lsp; add fields to the Claude entries.

decisions.decision: Round 3 gap 2: rustup puts a rust-analyzer proxy on the path.
decisions.ruling: U2 verifies in a scratch repo with rust that MISE_ENV=dev mise which rust-analyzer prints a path under the aqua install; if it prints the proxy, U2 stops with a question. K3 checks the same.

decisions.decision: Round 3 gap 3: the kotlin-lsp pin has macOS URLs only.
decisions.ruling: Out of scope: dev hosts are macOS only (the repo rule); code:lsp:check is a dev check, and CI does not run it.

decisions.decision: Round 4 gap 1: U4 runs U3's task but shares wave 2 with it.
decisions.ruling: U4 depends on U3 and moves to wave 3; the review, the docs and the gates move to waves 4, 5 and 6.

decisions.decision: Round 4 gap 2: active is not defined for a pin in both dev and ci, or a host server, when the tool's envs leave out dev.
decisions.ruling: One rule for every server: it is listed only when the tool's envs include dev and its source pin's requires_found is met (a host source has no requires_found). This replaces D12 and D19 as the full rule.

decisions.decision: Round 4 gap 3: code:lsp:check when bootstrap lsp --json fails.
decisions.ruling: Exit 2 from lsp goes through as exit 2, with its fix line; any other failure exits 1.

decisions.decision: Round 4 gap 4: can command hold spaces?
decisions.ruling: No: command is one binary; the rest goes in args (pyrefly [lsp]; dart [language-server, --protocol=lsp]; kotlin-lsp and typescript-language-server [--stdio]). check refuses a command with whitespace (added to D7).

decisions.decision: Round 4 gap 5: nothing verifies dart under flutter, pyrefly under pipx, or the gopls install.
decisions.ruling: Keep K4: a scratch repo selects flutter, python (with a pyproject.toml) and go; MISE_ENV=dev mise install runs; then code:lsp:check exits 0.

decisions.decision: Round 4 gap 6: a test of R1b or R1c can assert that code:lsp:check is not present.
decisions.ruling: U4 searches test/repo, and U1 the cli/ tests, for an assertion that code:lsp:check is not present, and updates it; if none exists, nothing changes.
